invariant.portable_principle: Share only one language-local fact collector when all immediate consumers need the same bounded project identity, source-role, native preflight, direct-symbol, source-preservation, and terminal-state facts; each consumer owns its report and review gate.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: No Python/Django mechanism is reused at runtime.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: TypeScript Compiler API identity/reference facts are not treated as interchangeable with PHP Composer/direct-symbol facts.
explicit_non_goals: No universal AST, call graph, semantic result schema, daemon, cache, or cross-language provider.
No framework, container, reflection, dynamic dispatch, inheritance, trait, external-consumer, behavioral-equivalence, safe-delete, or safe-refactor claim.
No tool installation, Composer install/update, plugin/script execution, or network operation.

syntax: PHP native php -l plus token_get_all(..., TOKEN_PARSE) is only a parse/preflight boundary.
The provider records malformed source as partial and never turns it into a clean absence claim.
type_system: The available PHP fact is deliberately narrower than a type checker: final Composer-owned class identity, direct $this member use, constructor parameters, direct named new expressions, and direct declared parameter/return types.

A project-local PHPStan/Psalm configuration/executable pair is fingerprinted and version-probed when present; an incomplete configured pair is a partial terminal state, not a fallback to guessed facts.
module_resolution: composer.json name/hash, composer.lock presence/hash, Composer validate state, and exact autoload.psr-4 mapping are frozen in every fact result.
A class is resolved only when its declared FQCN and source path exactly agree with the selected PSR-4 mapping.
runtime: Dynamic member names, class_alias, reflection-like names, containers, framework wiring, external callers, and unknown source roots are emitted as boundaries.
Direct static facts never authorize deletion, an enum migration, a sweep repair, consolidation, or a rename completion.
framework: Laravel, Symfony, WordPress, Drupal, and other framework contracts remain outside the PHP language-level outcome.

tooling.selected: PHP 8.4.2 at /opt/homebrew/bin/php; Composer 2.4.0 at /usr/local/bin/composer; Composer PSR-4 direct-symbol provider.

rejected_alternatives.ambient_phpstan_or_psalm: Neither was installed or downloaded. The lane cannot claim their reference/type output without a project-owned executable/configuration pair.
rejected_alternatives.token_only_semantics: Rejected: tokens support parsing but do not establish Composer class identity or direct resolved relationships.
rejected_alternatives.universal_semantic_provider: Rejected by the shared-kit decision; PHP facts, final reports, partiality, and human review schemas stay family-local.

tooling.version_and_resolution: Every artifact records PHP/Composer probes, Composer validation, Composer name/json/lock/PSR-4 identity, and configured PHPStan/Psalm status. Project-local analyzers are not installed or resolved from the network.
tooling.closure_mode: external-library: copied selected skill directory plus sibling _php-semantic/php_semantic_facts.php and _php-project-lexical/php_project_lexical.php.
preflight_and_failure_codes: complete exits 0; missing/old PHP or Composer, malformed source, unsafe Composer lock, missing/incomplete configured analyzer, and missing required human review exit 2 with a replacement partial artifact.
failing PHP lint, Composer validation, configured analyzer probe, or source-preservation check exits 1 with a replacement failed artifact.
unsafe inputs, output paths, review files, and malformed verdict files exit 64 before an unsafe write.

inputs: A regular Composer project root, selected non-symlink target, project-owned PHP and Composer executables, and an output below the consumer's reports root.
Hash-bound review files for implicit state and semantic duplication; hash-bound fixed-vocabulary verdicts for incomplete sweep triage.
structured_outputs: find-dormant: findings.json, report.md, facts.json with review_required candidates and certain_delete=0.
find-implicit-state: candidates.json, findings.json, report.md, facts.json; raw candidates are not promoted without a current review.
find-incomplete-sweep: manifest.json, findings.md, facts.json followed by triaged.json/triaged.md after a current verdict.
find-semantic-duplication: candidates.jsonl, findings.json, analysis.json, triage.md, facts.json; only confirm_candidate review results reach confirmed.
rename-concept: assessment.json, report.md, facts.json; a resolved identifier sweep still remains prose/runtime-review incomplete.
must_fire: One final-class private Job method with zero direct resolved $this calls becomes a human-review-only dormant lead.
One final string Job.state field with queued/running/done direct operations becomes a hash-reviewed implicit-state lead.
One old named RequestOptions construction misses region while three later direct constructions include it, producing a hash-verdict-gated sweep lead.
Two independent SummaryFactory methods return the same Composer-resolved Summary named-field shape, producing a hash-reviewed semantic-duplication lead.
LegacyStatus and CanonicalStatus declarations plus a direct LegacyStatus typed parameter establish a half-applied rename assessment.
must_not_fire: Generated, test, vendor, report, and symlink copies of tempting signals are inventoried as excluded and never nominate a lead.
A DynamicHandler method reached through $this->{$method} is uncertainty, not dormant evidence.
A one-operation label field, a wrapper relationship, different resolved return target, strings/comments, and unreviewed candidates are not promoted.
outcome_contract.native_test_command: composer validate --no-check-publish --no-interaction && php tests/lint.php && php tests/smoke.php
outcome_contract.native_guard_command: php -l each provider/adapter plus the copied external-library pytest replay

tests/test_php_a3_semantic_family.py proves positive, clean, role/symlink decoys, missing/old/failing/malformed/configured-tool boundaries, valid-failed-valid replacement, copied closure, human gates, native Composer/PHP checks, and source preservation.

known_false_positives: A zero direct $this call count can still be runtime-reachable; dormant output is review_required only.
Repeated string operations do not prove a closed domain; implicit-state requires a human verdict.
Similar direct constructor return shape is not behavioral equivalence; semantic duplication requires a human verdict.
A direct old symbol does not prove prose/runtime rename residue is complete.
known_false_negatives: Cross-object receiver calls, aliases not resolved by the bounded import parser, traits, inheritance, framework/container edges, dynamic construction, and external callers are deliberately withheld.
Incomplete sweep requires named arguments, one omission, a 4/3/75% group, and a monotonic Git trajectory.
legitimate_similar_shapes: Factory request variants can share a return shape but receive keep_separate human verdicts.
String labels and generated/vendor/test state terms are not first-party state authorities.

generalized: Composer identity can support a useful narrow semantic tier when every claimed FQCN/source relationship exactly matches declared PSR-4 ownership.
A language-local semantic provider is worthwhile when five consumers need the same native preflight, Composer identity, role exclusions, source manifest, direct relationship, and boundary facts.
did_not_generalize: Composer PSR-4 is not a substitute for PHPStan/Psalm reference/type facts.
The PHP provider cannot be promoted across PHP/Ruby/Swift or into a universal semantic platform.
Human review protocols vary by consumer and remain adapter-owned.

reuse_decision.actual_second_consumer: All five A3 consumers immediately consume identical Composer identity, source-role, native preflight, direct-symbol, boundary, source-manifest, and preservation facts while emitting distinct final artifacts.
evidence: ML-025 maintained physical LOC: provider 787 + adapters 723 + focused test 367 = 1,877 shared; mechanically copying the provider into each of five consumers is 5,025. Reduction is 62.6468% (gate >=25%).

Copied closure comparison replaces only the provider location. Shared-versus-literal growth is 23 bytes per consumer: dormant 0.00834%, state 0.00916%, sweep 0.00688%, semantic 0.00722%, rename 0.00899% (gate <=10%).
Sharing stays PHP-local and external-library-only. If a later consumer needs incompatible facts, copy this provider locally and delete the seam rather than widening it.

ruby.native_tool: Sorbet or Steep only when project-owned and configuration-complete

semantic_gaps: PHP PSR-4 identity does not transfer to Ruby

install_steps: Root later copies the selected skill and _php-semantic/_php-project-lexical siblings into the on-demand library; no ambient tool installation is needed.
Host invokes the PHP adapter with its Composer root and native PHP/Composer executables; human review files are required only where the skill contract requires a verdict.
agent_confusions: Composer identity is a bounded semantic fact, not a complete PHP reference/type index.
A configured but incomplete PHPStan/Psalm pair must remain partial; no fallback to string/token guesses is allowed.
repeated_work: Each independent consumer still runs one provider snapshot; request-level batching is not claimed.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: Measure a content-bound family coordinator only after at least two real user journeys show duplicated provider cost without weakening independent terminal statuses.

residual_risks: The direct-symbol parser intentionally does not establish PHP type/reference completeness; projects needing it require project-owned PHPStan/Psalm facts or remain partial.
The parent guide/router/coverage/matrix publication remains root-owned and is intentionally not edited in this lane.
